'''Yujin''' is an [[NPC]] in [[Central Plains]], [[Huanglong]]. He can be found alongside [[Liuhuo]] near a [[Resonance Beacon]] close to the ''Parallel Perception'' [[Sonoro Sphere]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yujin:''' Maybe I'm not cut out for this...
:'''Yujin:''' I thought that Central Plains would be perfect for a newbie investigator like me, with all its open terrain, villages and flowers.
:'''Yujin:''' Turns out I keep running into either [[Exiles]] or [[TD]]...
:'''Yujin:''' Can't beat 'em. What else can I do but run... Ugh, how pathetic...
:{{DIcon}} Take it slow, and you'll improve.
:'''Yujin:''' *sob* Thank you for letting me confide in.
:'''Yujin:''' Here's hoping that maybe one day, I'll become stronger, braver.
{{Dialogue End}}
